name: guest-count-picker
title: Guest Count Picker
description: Guest picker for adults, children and infants that asks each child's age, then flags a child over the age limit (or young enough to be a free infant), infants with no adult, rooms over capacity or out of cots, and a room split that doesn't match the party, with one-tap fixes.

meta.summary: Asks each child's age and checks the room split, so a hotel booking isn't bounced for an over-age child, a lone infant or an over-full room.
catches: Child older than the hotel's child age limit
Child young enough to count as a free infant
Infant or child in a room with no adult
Room over capacity or more infants than cots
Room split that doesn't add up to the party
limits: Defaults (child to 17, infant under 2, 4 per room, 1 cot) are typical, not any hotel's policy; pass your property's limits
Does not check live availability or pricing
a11y: Each counter is a spinbutton with min, max and now values, labelled, and works with arrow keys
The +/- buttons have aria-labels and are skipped in tab order (keyboard uses the spinbutton)
Age selects are labelled, with aria-invalid until chosen
Room split uses table roles with row and column headers
